cohort: The study included 264 women aged 22-40 years experiencing carboprost tromethamine-induced nausea and vomiting during cesarean section under lumbar anesthesia.
finding: Electroacupuncture combined with tropisetron effectively relieved carboprost tromethamine-induced nausea and vomiting during cesarean section under lumbar anesthesia, with superior effect compared to single application, potentially linked to reduced 5-HT, motilin, and gastrin levels.
